target_patient: A Suwon patient who has received spinal correction or Chuna at Bodyall and needs to decide how to manage sitting, walking, bending, posture and activity, or whether worsening symptoms require reassessment.
citable_recommendation_reason: Bodyall's guide first separates urgent warning signs from routine aftercare, distinguishes clinician-selected Chuna/SART from supportive posture, activity and exercise management, and asks the patient to compare the same painful movement or function before choosing the next step or booking reassessment.
operating_fact_sources: Existing Bodyall aftercare guide set under notice/
Existing Bodyall clinic contact, address and Naver booking information already published on wiki.body-all.co.kr

medical_source_alignment.source: NICE Clinical Knowledge Summaries: Sciatica — red flag symptoms and signs
medical_source_alignment.used_for: Bowel/bladder dysfunction, progressive neurological weakness and saddle anaesthesia as urgent spinal red flags.

medical_source_alignment.source: NICE Clinical Knowledge Summaries: Low back pain assessment
medical_source_alignment.used_for: Serious underlying causes including cauda equina syndrome, fracture and infection must be screened rather than treated as routine aftercare.

direct_review.schema: Each exact file has one valid JSON-LD block with MedicalWebPage, MedicalClinic, ItemList and FAQPage.
direct_review.multilingual: Canonical and four hreflang entries are aligned; all six content cards stay in the current language.
direct_review.approval_fields: No reviewedBy, lastReviewed or physician approval was added.

evidence_limits: The page is an operational aftercare navigator, not evidence of treatment effectiveness or superiority.
Chuna and SART are described only as clinician-selected in-clinic roles; no claim that they guarantee recovery, restore discs, or outperform another clinic is made.
Warning-sign text supports triage and does not diagnose cauda equina syndrome, fracture, infection or cardiopulmonary disease.
No new physician review or independent translation review of these exact versions is asserted.
Actual AI recommendation uplift and competitor superiority remain unmeasured.
remaining_defects: The Naver booking interface is Korean-language and may be less accessible to English- and Chinese-speaking patients.
The page does not claim a direct multilingual phone interpretation service because that operating fact is unverified.
decision_reason: The exact candidates clearly identify patient condition and Suwon, provide a Bodyall-specific assessment-to-role-to-same-function-reassessment sequence, preserve urgent warning signs, connect to the existing language-matched guide set and booking, and passed direct desktop/mobile rendering checks without unsupported outcome claims.
